name: Langreo (Spain)
description: Blue upper half, the lower half divided green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Langreo (a cross on green, a heart and a lamb).
history: Municipal flag of Langreo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: lower half divided green and white
